title.zh: Binance Pay lets visitors spend crypto at PayPay merchants in Japan
title.en: Binance Pay lets visitors spend crypto at PayPay merchants in Japan

current_state.zh: Binance Pay launched support for spending more than 100 cryptocurrencies at the vast majority of PayPay-supported merchants in Japan via the HIVEX QR interoperability framework, with USDT as the backend settlement layer and merchants receiving yen.
current_state.en: Binance Pay launched support for spending more than 100 cryptocurrencies at the vast majority of PayPay-supported merchants in Japan via the HIVEX QR interoperability framework, with USDT as the backend settlement layer and merchants receiving yen.
